story: Emma talks to Ali about how to stay healthy. She explains that eating good food and sleeping well is important. Ali learns that too much salt is dangerous for him.
title: Staying Healthy
setting: A bright kitchen with a table and chairs.

characters.name: Emma
characters.look: a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: a young man with black hair and a blue sweater

sentences.en: Emma wants to stay healthy every day.
sentences.zh: Emma 想要每天都保持健康。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma with short brown hair and a green shirt stands in a bright kitchen.

sentences.en: She eats fresh fruit and vegetable for lunch.
sentences.zh: 她午餐吃新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma puts a red apple and a green carrot on the table.

sentences.en: It is a fact that exercise is good.
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma points to a picture of a person running on the wall.

sentences.en: Ali needs to drink a lot of water.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali with black hair and a blue sweater holds a clear water bottle.

sentences.en: Too much salt is very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 太多的盐是非常危险的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali looks at a small white bowl of salt on the table.

sentences.en: Emma uses a toothbrush and toothpaste at night.
sentences.zh: Emma 在晚上使用牙刷和牙膏。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma holds a small blue toothbrush and a tube of toothpaste near a sink.

sentences.en: Do not forget to clean your mouth.
sentences.zh: 不要忘记清洁你的口腔。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma points to her mouth and smiles.

sentences.en: Keep your eye and ear very clean.
sentences.zh: 保持你的眼睛和耳朵非常干净。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma points to her eye and her ear.

sentences.en: Good sleep is also very important.
sentences.zh: 良好的睡眠也非常重要。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali lies down on a soft white pillow with his eyes closed.
